title: Affine rule for iterated finite averages
statement: Let $X$ and $Y$ be finite nonempty sets, let $c,d\in\mathbb R$, and let $g:X\times Y\to\mathbb R$. The uniform average over $x\in X$ of the uniform average over $y\in Y$ of $c+d g(x,y)$ equals $c+d$ times the corresponding iterated uniform average of $g(x,y)$.
